_how: This is the only file you edit by hand. Everything else in the estate reports itself. Keep it to things a machine cannot see: money, and the handful of actions that need a human.

money._note: Numbers, no currency symbols. Null prints as 'not recorded' — which is honest, and stops the dashboard inventing confidence.

owner_actions.what: Rotate the Whop account key and app key in the Whop dashboard
owner_actions.why: They are in a public repo and the API will not let anyone revoke them from outside
owner_actions.blocks: every Whop checkout (DeskOS, STPi, Mechanism Audit)

owner_actions.what: Create a Discord webhook and send it over
owner_actions.why: Jacaranda has no Discord webhook on the sheet; the other six ventures do

owner_actions.what: Create a Reddit script app at reddit.com/prefs/apps and send the client id + secret
owner_actions.why: The account exists; Reddit needs an app registration before it will accept a post

owner_actions.what: Sign up for Medium and Quora as jacarandalabs@atomicmail.io and send the handles
owner_actions.why: Neither platform has an API for new accounts; the drafts are written and waiting in outbox/

owner_actions.what: Add SMTP_HOST, SMTP_PORT, SMTP_USER, SMTP_PASS as repository secrets
owner_actions.why: Without them the three-touch sequence only drafts email; with them it sends, and the whole law-6 loop runs itself

owner_actions.what: Create an outreach Mastodon token (OUTREACH_MASTODON_TOKEN) and set OUTREACH_MASTODON_INSTANCE
owner_actions.why: Mastodon is the second rail that can send autonomously; Bluesky and WhatsApp have no send endpoint and will always draft

decisions.question: Which venture gets the next two weeks of selling attention?
decisions.default: Nothing happens. All seven keep running the rails and none gets pushed.

notes: Seven ventures, one operator. The rails publish on a 30-hour cadence without input. The press bank refills from public works and ventures until 2026-12; after that it needs new seed posts.
